title: Paid holidays for state government employees by US state, 2027
metric: Federal holidays on which state offices close + additional full paid state holidays. Floating days, half-days, county-only days and Confederate-era holidays are not counted.

extra.name: State Holiday (Good Friday)
extra.note: Unnamed 'State Holiday' observed on Good Friday (Apr 3, 2026; Mar 26, 2027; Apr 18, 2025). Pre-2015 this slot was Confederate Memorial Day (April 26 / 4th Monday in April); renamed 'State Holiday' by Gov. Deal in 2015, later settled on Good Friday. No longer carries a Confederate name or date.

extra.name: State Holiday (Friday after Thanksgiving)
extra.note: Unnamed 'State Holiday' (Nov 27, 2026; Nov 26, 2027). Pre-2015 this was Robert E. Lee's Birthday observance; renamed 'State Holiday' in 2015. No longer carries a Confederate name.

extra.name: Washington's Birthday (moved to Christmas week)
extra.rule: other:Washington's Birthday holiday is observed on a weekday adjacent to Christmas, set annually by the Governor (Fri Dec 26 in 2025, Thu Dec 24 in 2026, Thu Dec 23 in 2027)
extra.note: Official lists show 'Washington's Birthday: Monday, February 16 - will be observed Thursday, December 24' (2026). The Feb Monday is a normal workday.
